scope: isolated app, synthetic document task and synthetic encrypted archive
reboot_method: adb reboot, waited for sys.boot_completed=1, then wm dismiss-keyguard
limitations: Clean reboot only; power loss and filesystem corruption are not covered
Synthetic task and archive only; no production data was involved
The capability grant was in-memory, so not being inherited after reboot is expected by design rather than a new guarantee
A single device and single boot cycle were tested
